description: Required and optional fields for a Zeek modbus.log record delivered as one Kafka JSON message.

requiredFields.name: ts
requiredFields.notes: epoch seconds, fractional part allowed; negative rejected; stored at millisecond precision

requiredFields.name: uid
requiredFields.notes: Zeek uid; state identity only per the upstream feature contract's excluded_raw_fields -- not itself a feature

requiredFields.name: is_orig
requiredFields.notes: direction; source for the is_response feature (1=response, i.e. is_orig false; 0=request)

requiredFields.name: tid
requiredFields.notes: Modbus transaction id; keys the pending-TID state used by outstanding_requests_before_event, response_without_request, request_overwrite_same_tid, rtt_valid and rtt_s -- excluded from the feature vector itself as transaction state key only

requiredFields.name: func
requiredFields.notes: Modbus function code; source for the fc_1..fc_6/fc_other one-hot and the read/write ratio features

optionalFields.name: unit
optionalFields.notes: Modbus unit id; part of the sequence_context key (client_ip, server_ip, unit_id) together with the endpoint fields below, excluded from the vector itself as sequence key only. Some Zeek builds emit this field as uint instead of unit; either spelling is accepted

optionalFields.name: uint
optionalFields.notes: alternate spelling of unit id emitted by some Zeek builds; treated identically to unit

optionalFields.name: address
optionalFields.notes: register/coil address; source for address_value, address_present, address_delta_valid and address_delta

optionalFields.name: quantity
optionalFields.notes: register/coil count; source for quantity_value, quantity_present, quantity_delta_valid and quantity_delta

optionalFields.name: matched
optionalFields.notes: response causal-match flag; source for response_matched on a response record, ignored on a request

optionalFields.name: request_values
optionalFields.notes: array of numeric request values; source for request_values_present, request_value_count/min/max/mean

optionalFields.name: response_values
optionalFields.notes: array of numeric response values; source for response_values_present, response_value_count/min/max/mean

optionalFields.name: src_ip
optionalFields.notes: client address; part of the sequence_context key, excluded from the vector itself as state/orientation only

optionalFields.name: dst_ip
optionalFields.notes: server address; part of the sequence_context key, excluded from the vector itself as state/orientation only

optionalFields.name: src_port
optionalFields.notes: excluded from the vector itself as transport context only

optionalFields.name: dst_port
optionalFields.notes: excluded from the vector itself as transport context only

excludedRawFields.name: exception_code
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: zero Normal support in the training data

excludedRawFields.name: request_data
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: raw string, exact byte semantics not proven

excludedRawFields.name: response_data
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: raw string, exact byte semantics not proven

excludedRawFields.name: request_subfunction_code
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: zero Normal support in the training data

excludedRawFields.name: response_subfunction_code
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: zero Normal support in the training data

excludedRawFields.name: mei_type
excludedRawFields.notes: excluded per the upstream feature contract: zero Normal support in the training data

excludedRawFields.name: modbus_detailed_link_id
excludedRawFields.notes: not part of the upstream feature contract's feature_order or excluded_raw_fields list; carried by some Zeek builds but never read

invalidRecordPolicy: Malformed JSON or a missing required field routes to the modbus DLQ topic with a reason code; unknown additive fields are tolerated and ignored.
